# Boise Remodeling Co

> Design-build remodeling for kitchens, bathrooms, whole-home renovations, room additions, basements and ADUs in Boise, Idaho and the Treasure Valley. Founded 2020, part of P5 Home Co. Serving Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Nampa, Kuna, Star, Middleton, Caldwell. Phone (208) 477-1169.

Design-build means one accountable team handles design direction, estimating, Ada and Canyon County permitting, and construction under one contract, backed by a written scope before work starts and a workmanship guarantee at completion. Planning ranges come from an on-site estimator that prices the room, the scope and the finish level rather than a flat price per square foot; they are budget ranges, not quotes, and a firm proposal follows a free in-home visit.

## Services

- [Kitchen Remodel](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/kitchen-remodel): Custom kitchen renovations from cabinet refreshes to full gut-and-rebuild.
- [Bathroom Remodel](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/bathroom-remodel): Spa-quality bathroom transformations designed around how you actually live.
- [Whole-Home Remodel](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/whole-home-remodel): Cohesive whole-home renovations with a single project manager start to finish.
- [Room Addition](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/room-addition): Thoughtfully designed additions that feel like they were always part of your home.
- [ADU / Guest House](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/adu): Detached or attached accessory dwelling units designed to maximize your property value.
- [Basement Remodeling](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/basement-remodel): Finished basements and lower-level living space, from egress and framing to a fully finished suite.
- [Outdoor Living & Decks](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/outdoor-living): Decks, covered patios, and outdoor kitchens that extend your living space into the yard.
- [Aging-in-Place Remodeling](https://boiseremodeling.co/services/aging-in-place): Accessible, safe, and stylish remodels that let you stay in the home you love for the long term.
- [RE-10 / Inspection Repairs](https://boiseremodeling.co/re-10-repairs-boise): repairs from an Idaho RE-10 inspection response, completed and documented before closing, for real estate agents, buyers and sellers.
- [Estimate From Your Plans](https://boiseremodeling.co/remodel-plans-boise): upload construction drawings and get a remodeling planning range built from the room areas, ceiling heights and schedules on the sheets. Free, no obligation, and the homeowner confirms every measurement before anything is priced.
- [All Services](https://boiseremodeling.co/services): plus city pages at /services/{service}/{city} and [Service Areas](https://boiseremodeling.co/areas).
